req.title: /status/<code> accepts POST
req.statement: The system shall accept POST requests on /status/<code> and return the requested code.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /status/<code> must return the requested HTTP status code. I design tests covering: (1) a standard 2xx positive case (200), (2) a negative/client-error case (400), (3) boundary cases at the edges of common status code ranges (100, 299, 300, 500), (4) an invalid code negative path, and (5) a 5xx server-error code. Each test asserts the exact status code returned, catching off-by-one and comparison-operator mutations. The route handler in view_status_code calls status_code(code) which sets r.status_code = code, so exact equality assertions are the primary mutation-kill mechanism.
